title: The Carefree Banished Mage and His Childhood Friend, the Forest Goddess ~My Green Magic Was Deemed the Weakest in the Royal Capital, but Back in My Farming Village It’s All-Purpose~
description: Although Lute is a rare user of Green Magic, his ability is not recognized, and he is expelled from the Royal Vedere Magic Academy as incompetent mage. “There is more than one way to support the kingdom.” Thinking so, Lute decides to support the country with agriculture that utilizes green magic in his hometown of Porthos Village.. How will Lute's magic, which has become more and more powerful after training at the academy, change the village?
author: Kaede7
